title: 第019章 新手第三日四榜开放第020章 深潜者血肉畸变体
slug: 领主神级词条招募原罪堕天使
lines: 【叮：新手领主试炼期第三日已到，开放以下榜单，榜单前十者每日获得礼包一份！】
【叮：战力榜开放，财富榜开放，领地榜开放，领主之心榜开放！】
【叮：你已登上战力榜第一，是否隐藏姓名？】
迷迷糊糊间，苏业醒来，脑子还有些迷糊。
“隐藏！”苏业迷糊的选择了隐藏姓名。
穿好衣服，苏业走出了堕天圣堂，去混沌泉眼洗漱了一下，才回过神来。
“第三天了啊，四个榜单都开放了。”苏业打开了系统面板，看了看四个开放的榜单。
第一个战力榜。
第一名：姓名：隐藏，兵种：隐藏，战力：10w！
第二名：姓名：隐藏，兵种：隐藏，战力：1000！
“啊这？”苏业看着战力榜单上的排名，自己是第一个，战力是十万，这是按照领主领地的各种设施和建设来算的。
现在才三天，领地对于战力增幅的设施根本没有，也就是说是兵种综合战力来算的。
“还好自己隐藏了。”苏业看着战力排行榜，出名可不是什么好事情，尤其是领主世界。
其中不乏一些领主手下有占卜类的兵种，尤其是高阶领主，最喜欢做的事情，就是入侵新手领主掠夺他们的一切。
虽然说这是在领主世界是明令禁止的，但是私下里这么做的可不少，掠夺其他领主是积累最快的一个方式。
这可不是什么扮猪吃老虎，是真的会死的。
聊天频道也沸腾了。
【卧槽，战力榜第一的是十万，沃日，谁啊？】
【什么兵种能在三天抵达十万？扯淡吧，系统出问题了？】
【只有一个兵种能抵达，那就是科技侧的，科技侧的兵种运气好，三天抵达十万还是有可能的，尤其是高阶科技侧兵营的存在。】
【好像还真是，高阶科技侧兵营还真能。】
【科技侧兵种？散了吧，科技侧的兵种光辉也就在新手期绽放而已，新手期之后就泯然众人了，没意思，还以为是什么牛逼的兵种呢。】
【是啊，老子十阶的兵种都才一百不到的战力，除了科技侧真想不到什么兵种能抵达这个程度。】
【万一是神级兵种呢？笑jpg】
【神级兵种？扯淡，那玩意只存在于传说，想什么呢？根本就没有神级兵营的存在。】
苏业看着聊天频道的消息，心里放松了不少，科技侧，对自己就是科技侧的领主。
众所周知，科技侧的兵营最大的特点就是资源足够就能暴兵，所以有十万的战力有问题吗？完全没有任何问题。
随后苏业看了看其它榜单。
除了财富榜的第一，小小商人苏业认识之外，其它的都不认识。
领地榜第一的是一个名为，大地主的存在。
领主之心等级榜的是一个名为：天启的家伙。
苏业的三级领主之心，连前十都没上，上榜的基本是五级起步。
“离谱啊，数十亿的新手领主出现几个变态是正常的。”苏业看着这四个榜单，占据一个已经足够了。
至于其他的也就那样，财富榜不用想了，小小商人自己可比不了，其他榜单，倒是可以争取一下。
content_en:
[Ding: The third day of the novice lord trial period has arrived. The following list is open. The top ten on the list will receive a gift pack every day! 】
[Ding: The combat power list is open, the wealth list is open, the territory list is open, and the lord’s heart list is open! 】
[Ding: You have reached the top of the combat power list. Do you want to hide your name? 】
Drowsily, Su ye woke up, his mind still a little confused.
"Hide!" Su ye chose to hide his name in confusion.
After getting dressed, Su ye walked out of the Fallen Heaven Temple and went to the Chaos Spring to wash up before coming back to his senses.
"It's the third day. All four lists are open." Su ye opened the system panel and looked at the four open lists.
The first combat power list.
First place: Name: Hidden, Arms: Hidden, Combat Power: 100,000!
Second place: Name: Hidden, Arms: Hidden, Combat Power: 1000!
Third place:......
"Ah this?" Su Ye looked at the ranking on the combat power list. He was the first, with a combat power of 100,000. This was calculated based on the various facilities and construction in the lord's territory.
It has only been three days now, and the territory has no facilities for increasing combat power. In other words, it is calculated based on the comprehensive combat power of the arms.
"Fortunately, I hid it." Su Ye looked at the combat power rankings. Being famous is not a good thing, especially in the world of lords.
Some lords have divination-type troops under them, especially high-level lords. What they like to do most is to invade novice lords and plunder everything they have.
Although this is explicitly prohibited in the world of lords, many people do it privately. Looting other lords is the fastest way to accumulate.
This is not pretending to be a pig to eat the tiger, you will really die.
The chat channel is also abuzz.
[Holy shit, the number one on the combat power list is 100,000, Wori, who is that? 】
[What type of troops can reach 100,000 in three days? Nonsense, is there something wrong with the system? 】
[Only one unit can arrive, and that is the technology side. If the technology side is lucky, it is still possible to reach 100,000 in three days, especially with the presence of high-level technology side barracks. 】
[It seems that it is true, the high-end technology side barracks are really capable. 】
[Technology side arms? Come on, the brilliance of the technology-side troops only bloomed in the novice stage. After the novice stage, they disappeared from everyone. It was boring. I thought they were some awesome troops. 】
[Yes, I have tenth-level arms with less than a hundred combat strengths. I really can’t think of any arms that can reach this level except for the technological side. 】
[What if it’s a god-level unit? Laughing jpg]
[God-level arms? Nonsense, that thing only exists in legends, what are you thinking? There is no god-level barracks at all. 】
.............
Su Ye looked at the messages in the chat channel and felt a lot more relaxed. On the technology side, he was the leader of the technology side.
As we all know, the biggest feature of the military camp on the technology side is that it can attack troops with enough resources, so is there a problem with having a combat strength of 100,000? No problem at all.
Then Su ye looked at other lists.
Except for Su Ye, the small businessman who is number one on the wealth list, I don't know anyone else.
The first place on the territory list is a person named, a big landowner.
The one on the Lord's Heart level list is a guy named: Apocalypse.
Su Ye's third-level lord's heart is not even in the top ten, and those on the list basically start at level five.
"It's outrageous. It's normal for billions of novice lords to have a few perverts." Su ye looked at the four lists and found that occupying one was enough.
As for the rest, it's just like that. Don't worry about the wealth list. Small businessmen themselves can't compare. Other lists can be fought for.
